label: rs-perf-5y
_why: PERFORMANCE PROBE OF THE §10.98 ENTRIES (user, 2026-10-12: performance-oriented probes, possibly with inflated complexity, before any goal-oriented probe). Three arms alternated, n=3 each, 1836 -> 1841, read with tools/testbed/ledger/arm_tick_cost.mjs --ref rb: rb = the §10.97 book (no §10.98); rs = rb + §10.98; amp = rs with every research bar condition evaluated 10 times (perf_amplify_terms 10) and every monthly global and per-country fleet check run 10 times (perf_amplify_global 10). Predicted: rs within noise of rb (the new checks are plain country triggers and ~16 global blocks a month); amp shows the cost per unit if there is one.
_comparison: rs vs rb = the §10.98 cost; (amp - rs)/9 = the cost of one more copy of the checks. F220 for scale: research entries +3.1 s/yr, dams +1.8 s/yr over vanilla 55.8 s/yr.
